name: QA Decisions
description: One row per launch-QA-check decision, keyed by the curated check id (lip-sync, latency, ai-disclosure, voice-consent, script-safety, fallback, privacy, mobile). A row only exists once a human has decided on that check -- this replaces the retired app/.data/decisions.json handoff bucket with direct Busabase records, the same sparse-map shape (a check with no row yet is simply undecided).

agentPrompts.label: Record a QA gate decision
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-digital-human` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then record my verdict (approve / request changes / block) and note for the QA check I name — lip sync, latency, ai-disclosure, voice-consent, script-safety, fallback, privacy, or mobile. Never call a real digital-human vendor, TTS/STT, camera, or microphone to reach that verdict.

agentPrompts.label: What's blocking launch?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-digital-human` skill in this folder, then tell me which launch QA checks are still undecided or blocked, and which are already approved.
